implementation: Record raw storage exposure during checking, including string data, field/index address-taking, and permitted internal array/string header casts. scope: No language syntax or value-copy changes. Debug-visible owned locals, mutable/captured/raw-exposed parameters and function-containing values retain their existing safeguards. Other lowering effect scans still consume syntactic NF_MUT and are not changed by this stage.

reference_stage.purpose: Fixed stage reference; do not replace with a slower implementation.

instrumentation.explanation: Before deleting the scan, assert that any private parameter allowed by checker flags has no direct write/exposure identified by the scan. The first run found a false positive: Dewy permits mutable method selection by marking every receiver NF_MUT, even for a resolved read-only method such as Rational.gcd. The comparison scan was corrected to use the actual direct/indirect callable mutability mask; all 6007 tests then passed. This is corpus evidence, not a formal proof.
